body.name: Shifted-critical-cone local risk map
body.construction: At the local center set \(c_{0,0}=d_0^{\prime}A_0^+a_{0,0}\) and \(b_0=c_{0,0}-d_0^{\prime}w_0\). Compute \(\dot c(u)\) by differentiating the completion along \(\theta_n(u)\) at \(\theta_0\), compute \(h(u,t)=\arg\min_{h\in\mathcal C_0}\{\tfrac12h^{\prime}H_0h+Q(u,t)^{\prime}h\}\), and set \(\Psi_{\theta_0}(u,t)=a(u)+g^{\prime}h(u,t)\).
